patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Lemlist's shape. Choose Lemlist only if your buying job matches “Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo ” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans lead-management, email-outreach; Lemlist leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; Lemlist is Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo yearly; Enterprise custom; 14-day trial..
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning lead-management, email-outreach vs Lemlist-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Lemlist — Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer.

Limitations — BookYourData: —; Lemlist: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Lead database included but secondary to multichannel sending.
